claims.citation: New York Herald, 19 May 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Ship Corsica (of Thomaston), Havner, Liverpool April 4,
with mdse, to Snow & Burgess. Had continual heavy west-
erly gales to the Banks; washed away head rails, started cut-
water, stove hatch houses and split sails; from the Banks to
this port had light westerly and SW winds.

claims.citation: The Sun (New York), 19 May 1866, p. 4, col. 3

claims.verbatim:
Ship Corsica (of Thomaston), Havner, Liverpool 4th, with mdse. to
Snow & Burges. Had continued heavy westerly gales to the Banks;
washed away head sails, started cutwater, stove hatch houses, and split
sails; and from the Banks to this port, had light westerly and SW.
winds.

claims.citation: Lloyd's List, 29 May 1866, p. 4, col. 5 (British Newspaper Archive)
